checklist.requirement: One authenticated same-origin WebSocket per BoardApi multiplexes events and view presence; browser uses zero persistent HTTP event/presence streams.
Bootstrap sets the existing HttpOnly port-specific cookie before browser connection creation; credentials stay out of the URL.

Explicit development Origin works through the existing configuration; null and Sec-Fetch-Site cross-site stay rejected even when configured.
The server acknowledges the complete current project/session/document/view/generation identity only after ownership registration.
Strict bounded typed messages reject binary, malformed, excess-key, unsafe-id and invalid string/identity payloads.
checklist.boundary: Inbound server payload is capped at16KiB and compression is disabled; this review makes no claim about throughput/backpressure under hostile authenticated clients.

checklist.requirement: Cancellation releases only its owner; canceled and old-socket late acknowledgements cannot reconnect or close replacement owners.
